requirements: Product requirements, tests and marking should be verified against the current edition of the standard.
Products covered by the QCO/CRS order cannot be manufactured, sold or imported without valid BIS certification.
evidenceNeeded: Relevant test reports from a BIS-recognised lab
notes: Other parts of IS 9873 (flammability, migration of certain elements, etc.) also apply under the Toys QCO.
certificationStatus: Compulsory BIS certification (ISI mark) - verify current QCO
qcoStatus: Covered by a Quality Control Order issued under Section 16 of the BIS Act, 2016. Verify the current order, dates and any MSME relaxations.
regulatoryBasis: QCO under Section 16 of the BIS Act, 2016 (verify order)
enterpriseRelief: Check the QCO for MSME transition dates.

title: Declarations on Pre-Packaged Commodities - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
scope: Every pre-packaged product sold in India must declare manufacturer/packer name and address, net quantity, MRP, month and year of manufacture, and consumer care details.
requirements: Register as a manufacturer/packer with the Legal Metrology department where required.
Print the mandatory declarations on every package.
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs - Legal Metrology
certificationStatus: Mandatory for pre-packaged goods
qcoStatus: Not a BIS QCO. Mandatory under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
notes: Applies across categories whenever the product is sold pre-packed.
